cwdaemon_port.description: TCP port on which cwdaemon listens for incoming Morse code commands.

ptt_device.description: Device file used for PTT (Push-To-Talk) control, e.g., a parallel port, serial port, or USB device.

enable_speed_control.description: Whether clients may control CW speed (WPM) remotely via protocol.

min_speed.description: Minimum allowed CW speed in words-per-minute (WPM).

max_speed.description: Maximum allowed CW speed in words-per-minute (WPM).

default_speed.description: CW speed (WPM) used when no speed is specified by a client.

enable_qsk.description: Enable QSK (full break-in) operation if supported by your keyer hardware.

tone_release_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds after tone release (used when QSK is disabled).

key_input_device.description: Linux input device for physical key (e.g., /dev/input/event0). Leave blank to disable local key input.

enable_console.description: If enabled, display Morse audio/output on the local TTY console.

firmware_path.description: Path to firmware file for USB devices that require firmware upload on connect.

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed client IP addresses in CIDR notation. Empty list means allow all.

blocked_ips.description: List of blocked client IP addresses in CIDR notation. Overrides allowed_ips.

items.description: IP address or CIDR block to deny (e.g., '10.0.0.0/8').

outgoing_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to all outgoing messages (e.g., for identification).

enable_syslog.description: If enabled, send logs to the system syslog daemon.
